product_id: Service category; the example uses category 1.
eta: Estimated travel time to pickup, in seconds.
pcaa: Predicted customer cancellation probability after acceptance.
dcaa: Predicted resource-side cancellation probability after acceptance.
gmv: Estimated value of one matched pair.
pre_total_fee: Estimated request value, used when gmv is absent.
stage: Matching priority; higher values are processed first.
if_broadcast: Indicator that a pair was offered for assignment.
order_wait_time: Elapsed request waiting time, in seconds.
available_drivers: Number of available resources in the batch context.
pending_orders: Number of pending requests in the batch context.
pickup_distance: Estimated travel distance to pickup, in meters.
